extracted.name: Mom's Cucumber Salad
extracted.description: This cucumber salad made with sliced cucumbers tossed in a creamy, sweet and tangy dressing is a delicious summer salad that comes together quickly.
instruction_lines: Stir mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, dill, and seasoned salt together in a large bowl until sugar has dissolved. Stir in cucumber slices, tossing to coat.
